summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of a trust agreement for treasury share acquisitions. The trust, entered on February 9, 2026, with NH Investment Securities, expired on July 10, 2026. Total contract amount was KRW 500 billion. The termination required no board resolution under Korean law. The trust acquired 5,204,122 common shares (1.1% of total issued). The registrant's existing treasury holdings of 5,204,123 shares will be kept in its corporate account. The filing describes a routine expiration of a pre-established share buyback trust, falling under capital returns to shareholders. Watch for any subsequent buyback programs or changes in capital management strategy.
